headline: Indian Stocks Surge Led by Sensex and Nifty Amid Strong Corporate Earnings
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty surged over 2% for the week, driven by strong corporate earnings, declining crude oil prices, and sustained foreign portfolio inflows exceeding $4 billion.
why: Robust earnings and foreign institutional capital inflows are key drivers of domestic market performance and investor sentiment in emerging Asian economies.

impacts.name: BSE SENSEX
impacts.why: Strong corporate earnings and foreign fund inflows directly boost local equity index valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong corporate earnings, declining crude oil prices, and net foreign purchases surpassing $4 billion boosted investor morale and drove the benchmark indices higher.
